title: ULTRASOUND ABDOMEN, COMPLETE
author: Grace Lindqvist, MD
impression:
1. Hepatomegaly with moderate hepatic steatosis. No focal liver lesion.
2. Cholelithiasis without sonographic evidence of acute cholecystitis.

sections.heading: Indication
sections.text: Elevated ALT and AST. Obesity. Prediabetes.

sections.heading: Findings
sections.text:
Liver: 18.4 cm, enlarged. Diffusely increased echogenicity with posterior attenuation, consistent with moderate hepatic steatosis. No focal lesion. Smooth contour. Hepatopetal portal venous flow.
Gallbladder: Multiple mobile shadowing gallstones, largest 9 mm. No wall thickening or pericholecystic fluid. Sonographic Murphy sign negative.
Bile ducts: Common bile duct 4 mm.
Pancreas, spleen, kidneys, aorta: Unremarkable. Spleen 11.2 cm.

sections.heading: Impression
sections.text:
1. Hepatomegaly with moderate hepatic steatosis. No focal liver lesion.
2. Cholelithiasis without sonographic evidence of acute cholecystitis.

sections.heading: Recommendation
sections.text: Consider non-invasive fibrosis assessment (FIB-4 or elastography) if not already done.
